martridge.voice_description: An old wizard, small in stature but vain about his power: reedy, precise, theatrical, a touch pompous, quick to take offence and to boom when angered. Elderly, dry, slightly crackly, clear diction.
martridge.preview_text: I am a great magician. I am nothing of the sort! You cannot measure magic by size! Of course I am.. just not physically. If you would like to learn more.. Come to my hidden cabin. Good point. It lies behind some trees north-east of here. DON'T ANGER ME, HUMAN!

milder.voice_description: A young man of about twenty, the village bully: big, smug and slow-drawling, mocking and pleased with himself, with a braying laugh. Deeper and more confident than the hero he taunts, small-town American.
milder.preview_text: Well, lookie what we got here. Nothing. 'cept to watch you work... Is pig farming fun? Are you feeding pigs right now? Bawahahahah! See you around, squirt.

mother.voice_description: A middle-aged farm mother: brisk, dry and warm underneath, unimpressed by her son's nonsense, quick with a put-down. Plain small-town American, medium pitch, unhurried, a little tired.
mother.preview_text: Dink, it's getting late! No food until you feed the pigs! Dink, can you do something for me? Can you go out to the woods and see if you can get, some AlkTree nuts, I think they're in season. You're a dear. That's very amusing, Dink. You get the sack of feed, and you sprinkle it in the pig pen. And don't tease them! You'll get over it. Good boy. Go visit our neighbors while I prepare dinner.

king.voice_description: A king in late middle age: warm, resonant and formal, genial and amused, used to being obeyed, grave when the news is bad. Measured pace, rounded vowels, a mild old-fashioned courtly manner.
king.preview_text: Hello, Dink. I've heard much about you - it is good to finally meet you. Now what is it I can help you with? Ahh, the famous Dink Smallwood sense of humor I heard so much about! You Dink? It is suicide. And I cannot refuse you. Go north from this castle until you hit the cliffs. I will have men there to guide you through the passage. SMALLWOOD HAS RETURNED! Hooray! The world is safe!

dink.voice_description: A young man, a pig farmer's son of about eighteen who insists he is a warrior: cocky, sarcastic, quick to sulk, with a plain small-town American accent. Energetic and a little nasal, comic timing, not heroic.
dink.preview_text: I'm NOT a pig farmer. Boy? Please refer to me as warrior from now on. Hey, that's Lyna with Milder Flatstomp! I HATE that guy! Why must I attack furniture? Smells damp in here. I don't like this one bit... This cave sucks, let's leave... WATER MUST DIE!

seth.voice_description: An ancient, inhuman sorcerer: deep, slow and resonant, calm and contemptuous, every word deliberate, with a cold amusement that breaks into a furious roar. Ageless, sepulchral, slightly unnatural, as if speaking from a great hall.
seth.preview_text: I am the beginning and the end. I am everything you love. I am everything you despise. FEEL MY WRATH, SMALLWOOD! MOTHER!!!!!!!!!!

mog.voice_description: A goblin king: huge, guttural and gravelly, slow and proud, grieving then enraged. Deep chest voice with a rough growl under it, deliberate, booming when he shouts, clearly a monster but fluent and regal.
mog.preview_text: Who dares wake the mighty Mog, king of Goblins? Of course. I was raised by.. what is this? My comrades litter the ground! You? YOU? I MUST AVENGE MY BROTHERS!
